## Calculate the FY2023 Gross margin percentage and project the FY2024 Revenue and Gross margin.
Calculate the FY2023 Gross margin percentage: ($278,002 thousand / $422,179 thousand) * 100 ≈ 65.85%.

## Identify FY2023 operating expenses (excluding restructuring) and project FY2024 operating expenses.
Within the 'SENTINELONE, INC. CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF OPERATIONS' table on document page 91, find the column for the year ended January 31, 2023.
Locate the row labeled 'Research and development'. The value for FY2023 is $207,008 thousand.

Locate the row labeled 'General and administrative'. The value for FY2023 is $162,722 thousand.
Locate the row labeled 'Restructuring (Note 11)'. The value for FY2023 is $0 thousand.
Assume that R&D, S&M, and G&A dollar amounts remain the same in FY2024 as in FY2023, and restructuring is $0 in FY2024.
Projected FY2024 Operating Expenses = R&D (FY2023) + S&M (FY2023) + G&A (FY2023) + Restructuring (FY2024)
Projected FY2024 Operating Expenses = $207,008 thousand + $310,848 thousand + $162,722 thousand + $0 thousand = $680,578 thousand.
solution_steps.4:
## Calculate the projected FY2024 Gross profit and Operating income.
Calculate Projected FY2024 Gross profit: Projected FY2024 Revenue * Projected FY2024 Gross margin percentage.
Projected FY2024 Gross profit = $633,268.5 thousand * 0.7085 ≈ $448,666 thousand.
Calculate Projected FY2024 Operating income: Projected FY2024 Gross profit - Projected FY2024 Operating Expenses.
Projected FY2024 Operating income = $448,666 thousand - $680,578 thousand = -$231,912 thousand.
The projected operating income in FY2024 under the given assumptions is
-$231,912 thousand
